description: This file contains an abstract test class 'CopierTester' for testing serialization copying mechanisms within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines test methods for verifying deep copy correctness, reference handling, and collection serialization. The class is designed to be inherited and specialized for specific types and copiers.

classes.name: CopierTester
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing deep copying functionality of serializers for custom types within Orleans.Serialization. Uses dependency injection to set up serializers and provides test methods for copying validation and reference counting.

methods.name: CopierTester
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test class, setting up dependency injection and serializer configurations based on generic parameters.

methods.name: CreateCopier
methods.description: Creates an instance of the copier under test via dependency injection.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Abstract method to create a test value of type TValue.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Virtual method to compare two TValue instances for equality.
